welcome.title: A desktop workbench for Pi coding agent
welcome.subtitle: Local-first sessions, model controls, and recoverable agent state.
welcome.onboardingIntro: Open a workspace directory to start a Pi session. Pi reads your project files, responds to prompts, and edits code — all with full context of your repository.
welcome.step1: Click Open workspace and select your project folder
welcome.step2: Type <kbd>/goal</kbd> to set an objective, or just start chatting
welcome.step3: Review changes in the Git panel, then stage and commit
